versions.changelog: 正式产品重构：聚焦企业问题、经营影响、优先AI场景、人工边界与最小验证，并接入蓝图FDE公网落地入口。
Initial public release: three enterprise AI adoption samples, HTTPS FDE API, separate storage/contact consent, deletion and privacy controls.

Initial release of enterprise-ai-landing-guide.

- Provides a guided process (max 6 questions) to help enterprises identify an AI-priority scenario that can be validated within 7 days.
- Separates user statements, document evidence, AI inferences, and pending confirmations; does not invent business data or outcomes.
- Enforces strict privacy: does not request contact info before the scenario map stage; separates consent for data storage and contact.
- Only initiates human review (FDE) after explicit user consent and company name provision.
- Offers a CLI adapter for interacting with the API using Python standard library.
- Implements robust error handling and clear downgrade modes for connectivity or authorization issues.
